text: EX-99.1 2 eqt-ex991earningsreleasexl.htm EX-99.1 Document EQT Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results CANONSBURG, October 27, 2026 -- EQT Corporation (NYSE: EQT) today announced financial and operational results for the third quarter of 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Results: • Production : Sales volume of 583 Bcfe, inclusive of 21 Bcfe of strategic curtailments • Capital Expenditures : $638 million, 10 % below the low-end of guidance, driven by lower-than-expected upstream and midstream spending and continued benefit from operational efficiency gains • Realized Pricing : Differential of $(0.64) favorable to guidance despite widening basis during the quarter due to benefits from marketing optimization and curtailment strategy • Operating Costs : Total per unit operating costs of $1.09 per Mcfe, at the low end of guidance driven by lower-than-expected LOE and production tax • Cash Flow : Net cash provided by operating activities of $1,083 million; generated free cash flow attributable to EQT (1) of $283 million • Balance Sheet : Exited the quarter with $5.6 billion total debt and just under $5.5 billion net debt (1) Third Quarter 2026 and Recent Highlights: • Range Acquisition: Announced strategic acquisition of Range Resources Corporation, which will create America's largest and only vertically integrated natural gas producer with leading inventory depth, lowest cost structure, a fortress balance sheet and the largest natural gas marketing platform in the country • POWER Pipeline : Launched open season for new 42-inch POWER Pipeline project connecting EQT's core Marcellus assets in Pennsylvania to growing demand at the Clarington hub in Ohio • LNG Sales Contract : Signed 10-year LNG sales agreement with Ignitis Group, the largest supplier of electricity and natural gas in Lithuania • Gulf Coast Storage : Contracted for 7 Bcf of storage capacity at Leaf River Energy Center's salt dome expansion project along the Gulf Coast; increases EQT's Gulf Coast storage capacity up to 11 Bcf and provides optimization flexibility to support the LNG business • Dividend Increase : Increased dividend by 3% to $0.68 per share annualized; compounded annual dividend growth rate of ~7% since 2022 with durability underpinned by material cost structure improvements and synergy capture over this period President and CEO Toby Z. Rice stated, "Third quarter results built on what has been an exceptional year of execution at EQT. Despite downward pressure on natural gas prices during the quarter, our marketing efforts drove stronger realized pricing, operating expenses came in at the low end of guidance and capital spending was well below expectations as efficiencies continue to accrue. This resulted in yet another quarter of greater-than-expected free cash flow generation." Rice added, "We also announced our strategic combination with Range Resources, pairing two of the highest-quality, longest-duration asset bases in North America and creating a company uniquely positioned for the next era of natural gas. Our expanded resource base solidifies EQT as the operator of choice for premium, long-term supply arrangements and provides unique growth optionality underpinned by contractual demand. We believe this combination creates a must-own energy company capable of generating durable, through-cycle free cash flow while compounding value for shareholders for decades to come." title: EQT Corp 8-K: Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement; Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure; Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits
text: Item 1.01. Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement. On October 25, 2026, EQT Corporation, a Pennsylvania corporation (“EQT”), EQT Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT, Rhino Merger Sub Inc., a Delaware corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT (“Merger Sub”), and Rhino Merger Sub LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT (“LLC Sub”), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with Range Resources Corporation, a Delaware corporation (“Range”). Upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, which has been unanimously approved by the board of directors of EQT (the “EQT Board”) and by the board of directors of Range, Merger Sub will merge with and into Range (the “First Merger”), with Range surviving as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT (the “First Step Surviving Corporation”), and as the second step in a single integrated transaction with the First Merger, the First Step Surviving Corporation will merge with and into LLC Sub (the “Second Merger” and, together with the First Merger, the “Merger”), with LLC Sub surviving the Second Merger as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of EQT. At the effective time of the First Merger (the “Effective Time”), among other things, each share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of Range (“Range Common Stock”) that is issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (including Range restricted stock awards but excluding Excluded Shares (as defined in the Merger Agreement)) will be converted into the right to receive, without interest, 0.987 (the “Exchange Ratio”) shares of common stock, no par value, of EQT (“EQT Common Stock”), with cash in lieu of fractional shares. Following the closing of the First Merger (the “Closing”), EQT’s existing shareholders and Range’s existing stockholders will own approximately 73% and 27%, respectively, of the combined company on a fully diluted basis. Governance In the Merger Agreement, EQT has agreed to increase the size of the EQT Board to 12 members and appoint Dennis L. Degner, who is currently Range’s Chief Executive Officer and President, and one other individual selected by Range (who shall satisfy the independence requirements of the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) with respect to service on the EQT Board), after reasonable consultation with EQT and with the consent of EQT (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed), (the “Range Designees”) to the EQT Board at the Effective Time. EQT has also agreed that, following the Closing, EQT will take all necessary action to nominate the Range Designees for election to the EQT Board at the first annual meeting of shareholders of EQT thereafter. Conditions to the Merger The completion of the First Merger is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of certain closing conditions, including (i) the adoption of the Merger Agreement by the holders of a majority of the voting power of the outstanding shares of Range Common Stock entitled to vote thereon (the “Range Shareholder Approval”) at the special meeting of Range stockholders to be held for the purpose of adopting the Merger Agreement (including any adjournments or postponements thereof, the “Range Stockholders’ Meeting”), (ii) the approval of the issuance of the shares of EQT Common Stock in connection with the First Merger (such shares, the “EQT Shares” and such issuance, the “Share Issuance”) by a majority of the votes cast (the “EQT Shareholder Approval”) at the special meeting of EQT shareholders to be held for the purpose of approving the Share Issuance (including any adjournments or postponements thereof, the “EQT Shareholders’ Meeting”), (iii) the EQT Shares being approved for listing on the NYSE, (iv) there being no law, injunction, order or decree prohibiting consummation of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement (the “Transactions”), (v) the expiration or termination of (a) all waiting periods (and any extensions thereof) applicable to the Transactions under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, and (b) any commitment to, or any agreement with, any governmental entity to delay the consummation of the Transactions or to not consummate the Transactions before a certain date (such condition, the “HSR Act Condition”), (vi) the effectiveness of the registration statement on Form S-4 to be filed by EQT with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) pursuant to which the EQT Shares will be registered, (vii) no Company Material Adverse Effect and no Parent Material Adverse Effect (each as defined in the Merger Agreement) having occurred since the date of the Merger Agreement, and (viii) subject to certain materiality qualifications and exceptions, the accuracy of each party’s representations and warranties and each party’s compliance with, or waiver of its obligations under, if permissible, its covenants in the Merger Agreement. 1 Non-Solicitation of Competing or Alternative Proposals Each of EQT and Range has agreed, subject to certain exceptions with respect to unsolicited proposals, not to directly or indirectly solicit competing acquisition proposals or to enter into discussions concerning, or provide confidential information in connection with, any alternative acquisition proposals. However, if, after the date of the Merger Agreement but prior to obtaining its requisite shareholder approval relating to the Merger, EQT or Range receives an unsolicited, bona fide written acquisition proposal from a third party that did not result from a material breach of the non-solicitation provisions of the Merger Agreement and its board of directors concludes in good faith, after consultation with its financial advisors and outside legal counsel, that such unsolicited, bona fide written acquisition proposal constitutes, or would reasonably be expected to result in, a superior offer, EQT or Range, as applicable, may furnish non-public information regarding it or any of its subsidiaries and engage in discussions and negotiations with such third party in response to such unsolicited, bona fide written acquisition proposal; provided that EQT or Range, as applicable, provides notice and furnishes any non-public information provided to the maker of the acquisition proposal to the other party substantially concurrently with providing such non-public information to the maker of the acquisition proposal. title: EQT Corp 8-K exhibit 99.1 (press release)
text: EX-99.1 3 ea030960101ex99-1.htm JOINT NEWS RELEASE, DATED OCTOBER 26, 2026, ISSUED BY EQT CORPORATION AND RANGE RESOURCES CORPORATION Exhibit 99.1 EQT Announces Strategic Acquisition of Range Resources, Creating America’s Undisputed Natural Gas Champion Canonsburg, PA and Fort Worth, TX, October 26, 2026 -- EQT Corporation (“EQT”) (NYSE: EQT) and Range Resources Corporation (“Range”) (NYSE: RRC) today announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement, under which EQT will acquire Range in an all-stock transaction to create America’s leading natural gas company with a pro forma enterprise value over $50 billion. The combination brings together two of the highest-quality natural gas assets in North America, creating America’s largest and only vertically integrated natural gas producer with leading inventory depth and low-cost structure. Combined with a fortress balance sheet and the largest natural gas marketing platform in the country, these differentiated attributes solidify EQT as the operator of choice in the next era of demand-led natural gas growth. Transaction Creates America’s Natural Gas Champion ● Asset Scale : Combined company will have >9 Bcfe/d of net production and >30 years of inventory across nearly 3 million net acres in addition to >3,700 miles of critical midstream infrastructure ● Strategic Positioning : Transaction positions EQT as the clear partner of choice for end users of natural gas, enhancing EQT’s abilities to serve Appalachian demand growth ● Cost Structure : Improves EQT’s unlevered free cash flow breakeven (1) to less than $2 per MMBtu while increasing NGL diversification, ensuring robust free cash flow through all parts of the commodity cycle ● Synergy Value : Expect $325 million of base annual synergies within two years across corporate, operations and commodities marketing, with a pathway to more than $600 million long-term from development and infrastructure optimization, improved margins from natural gas, LNG and NGL marketing efforts, and the ability to accelerate inventory development into contractual demand-led growth ● Financial Profile : 100% stock transaction with a pro forma enterprise value of more than $50 billion; further strengthens EQT’s balance sheet and is expected to provide BBB quality credit metrics at closing ● Earnings Power : Cumulative free cash flow (1) projected to be ~$20 billion over the next five years at recent strip pricing, creating shareholder value beyond what either company could achieve standalone (1) A non-GAAP financial measure. See the Non-GAAP Disclosures section of this news release for the definition of, and other important information regarding, this non-GAAP financial measure. Unlevered free cash flow breakeven is defined as the average Henry Hub price needed to generate positive unlevered free cash flow. EQT President and CEO Toby Z. Rice stated, “This transaction brings together two of the highest-quality, longest-duration asset bases in North America and creates a company uniquely positioned for the next era of natural gas. As the lowest-cost natural gas producer in the industry, supported by multiple decades of high-quality inventory, the combined company will offer exceptional resilience through commodity cycles while maintaining significant upside to strengthening natural gas fundamentals. Additionally, our expanded resource base solidifies EQT as the operator of choice for premium, long-term supply arrangements and provides unique growth optionality underpinned by contractual demand. We believe this combination creates a must-own energy company capable of generating durable, through-cycle free cash flow while compounding value for shareholders for decades to come.” “This combination of two highly successful operators with decades of inventory creates opportunities to build long-term value neither could fully realize independently,” said Dennis L. Degner, President and CEO of Range. “Our Board of Directors unanimously determined that this transaction will enhance Range shareholders’ ability to participate in a constructive long-term natural gas and NGL macro outlook. The combined company will be uniquely positioned to capitalize on increasing demand for natural gas and liquids both domestically and internationally, delivering superior returns for investors. I want to thank our employees, whose hard work, dedication and commitment have positioned us to enter this next chapter of value creation with EQT.” Transaction Details Under the terms of the merger agreement, unanimously approved by the Board of Directors of both companies, EQT will acquire Range in an all-stock transaction. Each outstanding share of Range common stock will be exchanged for 0.987 shares of EQT common stock. As a result of the transaction, EQT’s existing shareholders are expected to own approximately 73% of the combined company and Range’s shareholders are expected to own approximately 27%. The transaction is expected to close during the first quarter of 2027, subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and clearances, approval of the transaction by shareholders of both EQT and Range, and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. Upon the closing of the transaction, two representatives from Range, including Dennis Degner, will join EQT’s Board of Directors. EQT’s executive management team will lead the combined company with headquarters remaining in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania. Advisors Citi and RBC Capital Markets, LLC acted as financial advisors to EQT. Kirkland & Ellis LLP is serving as EQT’s legal counsel on the transaction. Evercore acted as lead financial advisor, J.P. Morgan Securities LLC also advised Range. Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher LLP is serving as Range’s legal counsel on the transaction. Conference Call and Webcast Information EQT and Range will hold a joint conference call to discuss the details of the transaction at 8:00 AM ET today, October 26, 2026, which will be broadcast live via webcast. The live audio webcast and accompanying presentation is available on EQT’s investor relations website, ir.eqt.com, under “Events & Presentations” and on Range’s investor relations website, ir.rangeresources.com, under “News & Events.” A replay will be archived in the same locations after the conclusion of the live event. As a result of the announced transaction, EQT and Range are canceling their previously scheduled Q3 2026 earnings conference calls on October 28, 2026. Both companies will issue their Q3 2026 earnings results, as previously announced, after the market close on October 27, 2026. title: Additional Reconsideration Standards of Performance for New, Reconstructed, and Modified Sources and Emissions Guidelines for Existing Sources: Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review
text: Additional Reconsideration Standards of Performance for New, Reconstructed, and Modified Sources and Emissions Guidelines for Existing Sources: Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review (Environmental Protection Agency). The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is proposing amendments to the New Source Performance Standards and Emission Guidelines for the Crude Oil and Natural Gas Source Category to address additional concerns raised with prior regulatory amendments finalized in March 2024. Specifically, the EPA is proposing changes in response to certain petitions for reconsideration of the March 2024 amendments, changes based on policy decisions and supporting legal interpretations, and changes that correct and clarify the regulatory text of the new source performance standards and emission guidelines. First, the EPA proposes to rescind the Super Emitter Program. Second, the EPA proposes to subcategorize different types of well sites affected and designated facilities to address issues related to the requirements finalized in March 2024 for marginal well sites and conventional well sites. Third, the EPA proposes changes to address issues related to liquids unloading, process controllers, pumps, fugitive emissions, storage vessels, covers and closed vent systems, equipment leaks at gas plants, and associated gas. Fourth, the EPA proposes changes to certain requirements finalized in March 2024 related to control devices and to provide owners and operators the option to conduct optical gas imaging surveys according to Appendix K for gas processing facilities. Lastly, the EPA proposes changes to correct inadvertent errors and to clarify regulatory language.

title: Air Plan Approval and Air Quality Designation; TN; Attainment Plan and Redesignation of the Sullivan County Nonattainment Area for the 2010 1-Hour Primary SO2 NAAQS
text: Air Plan Approval and Air Quality Designation; TN; Attainment Plan and Redesignation of the Sullivan County Nonattainment Area for the 2010 1-Hour Primary SO2 NAAQS (Environmental Protection Agency). The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA or Agency) is proposing to approve the State of Tennessee's attainment plan for the Sullivan County Nonattainment Area (Sullivan County Area or Area) for the 2010 Sulfur Dioxide (SO<INF>2</INF>) National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS). Additionally, the EPA is proposing to determine that the Area has attained the 2010 SO<INF>2</INF> NAAQS and to approve Tennessee's maintenance plan for continued attainment. With these approvals, the EPA is proposing to approve Tennessee's comprehensive source-specific SO<INF>2</INF> permitted limits for two facilities in the Area, other control measures, and provisions for Reasonably Available Control Measures (RACM) and Reasonably Available Control Technology (RACT), reasonable further progress (RFP), a modeling demonstration of SO<INF>2</INF> attainment and maintenance, and to approve Tennessee's request to redesignate the Area from nonattainment to attainment of the 2010 SO<INF>2</INF> NAAQS. The EPA is taking these actions in accordance with the Clean Air Act (CAA or Act).
